finalText:
Done. The `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon` endpoint is implemented following the existing layering.

What changed:

- [src/services/orderService.ts](/work/src/services/orderService.ts) — `applyCoupon(id, body)` holds all rules: code normalization (trim + upper), then validation in the exact error-table order (request → order → coupon → time window → usage → minimum), discount math (FIXED / PERCENT with `floor`, cap, clamp to amount), and orchestration of the atomic write.
- [src/repositories/redemptionRepository.ts](/work/src/repositories/redemptionRepository.ts) — new repository whose `apply()` runs the order update, `coupon_redemptions` insert, and `used_count + 1` inside one `BEGIN/COMMIT` with `ROLLBACK` on error. All SQL lives here.
- [src/routes/orders.ts](/work/src/routes/orders.ts) — route parses the id/body and delegates to the service.
- [src/app.ts](/work/src/app.ts) — wires the new repository into `OrderService`.
- [tests/applyCoupon.test.ts](/work/tests/applyCoupon.test.ts) — 21 new tests covering AC-01 through AC-10 plus each error code and DB-unchanged-on-rejection.

Notes on the tricky cases: `now == validUntil` rejects while `now == validFrom` succeeds, the order's stored `amountCents` is used (not the reduced final amount) for the minimum and percent base, and the first-use check precedes coupon lookup so an already-used order wins over an unknown-code error.

Verification: `npm run build` passes and `npm test` reports 26 tests passing (5 existing + 21 new). TASK.md and the existing test file were left untouched.
